## Online Multiplayer Beta — community testers wanted

This opt-in beta adds experimental System Link multiplayer for Windows and Linux. Internet testing currently requires a private VPN between players; there is no built-in matchmaking, relay or NAT traversal.

**Please help us test and report any issues you experience! Successful test reports are welcome too.**

- [Setup and testing guide](https://github.com/8bitninja64/TenchuZ-PC/blob/v0.4.0-beta.1/docs/multiplayer-beta.md)
- [Report a multiplayer issue or successful session](https://github.com/8bitninja64/TenchuZ-PC/issues/new?template=multiplayer-beta.yml)

Download the ZIP for Windows or tar.xz for Linux below (not the source-code archive). Extract into a new folder, keep portable.txt, and run the game once to prepare your own disc. Then use Multiplayer.cmd on Windows or `sh Multiplayer.sh` on Linux. Everyone must use this beta and start testing at 30 FPS. Keep your stable installation and saves separate.

Verified so far: four Windows processes completed an assisted mission; a headless Linux host and Windows guest entered a mission and returned; Linux peers handled simulated delay, jitter, packet loss and restart/rejoin after an outage. These are local/virtual tests. Real internet play, hardware SteamOS missions, mixed FPS and normal-combat synchronization still need testing. No voice chat or console compatibility is promised.

When reporting, include the beta version, OS/GPU for each player, player count, host/guest roles, LAN/VPN setup, mission, FPS, reproduction steps, and logs from both sides. Review logs for personal paths/IP addresses; do not upload game data or compiled modules.

This is a prerelease, not a replacement for stable v0.3.5. It is not offered by the stable auto-updater. No game data is included.
